title: Illustration family

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study

slide_intent: Show variation within one drawing language so designers can judge which features keep a family coherent.
strategic_value: Shared flat colors and outlined hands can connect Burger King’s food, people and playful motifs.
demonstration: Seven adjacent panels combine a held burger, ketchup packet, cucumber eyes, stacked burger, fries mouth, onion rings and ice cream.
practical_value: Compare shape simplification, line use and color across different subjects.

content_islands.name: Upper panels
content_islands.spec: Place held food, ketchup and a face with cucumber slices across the upper row.

content_islands.name: Lower panels
content_islands.spec: Group stacked ingredients, fries mouth, onion-ring hand and ice cream below.

reference_purposes.Expression: The collage shows one flat illustration language spanning food and human gestures.
